race.description: Good As Gold John Cormie Rip (Bm50) Hcp
race.comment: WOOTTON PLEASE (8) went forward and proved too strong last time out, scoring by a long neck over 1400m at Taree. This doesn't look as hard and is sure to be there at the business end. PRINCE RUPERT (5) finished out of the money two starts back then he was always well out of his ground when seventh in a 1000m contest at Muswellbrook two-and-a-half weeks ago. Has the class to find the winners' list. PATTERA (3) finished a long neck from the winner in fourth last start after being prominent at the corner over 1100m at Cowra. Nicely placed to feature in the finish. BATTLE REIGN (7) produced another moderate effort last start when tenth over 1200m at Tamworth at the second run back from a spell. Nicely placed to find some form.
